roots.origin: 拉丁语 praeesse（在前、主事），由 prae（在前）＋ esse（是、在）构成；分词 praesens 表「正在眼前的」，英语 present 由此
roots.core_concept: being right here in front, not elsewhere / 人就在眼前这儿，不在别处
roots.core_image: 点名点到的人应了一声，抬头就能看见他站在那儿
roots.english_definition: to be at hand, be in front

roots.origin: 拉丁语 profiteri（公开承认、当众声明），由 pro（在众人前）＋ fateri（承认）构成；过去分词 professus。与 profile 的 filum（线）一支毫无关系，勿混
roots.core_concept: to declare one's standing out loud before all / 当众把自己的名分说出口
roots.core_image: 他站到众人面前开口，把自己认下的那门本事讲明

roots.origin: 拉丁语 filum（线、丝），意大利语 profilare 是 pro（沿着）＋filare（拉线）→「沿轮廓描一条线」，英语 profile 由此；filament、file（成列）同出此支。与 profiteri（当众声明）只是都带 pro-，词源无关
roots.core_concept: a thread drawn along an edge / 沿着边缘拉出的一条线
roots.core_image: 笔尖贴着侧脸的边一路描下去，只留一条轮廓线

roots.origin: 拉丁语 sperare（盼望），spes（希望）；prosperus 本义「合所盼的」（pro＋spes），故 prosper 表事情顺着所盼往好处走。desperate（绝望）反用此根
roots.core_concept: things going the way one hoped / 事情顺着所盼的那样走
roots.core_image: 禾苗一天比一天高，秋后果然收成压弯了车

roots.origin: 拉丁语 quartus（第四的），来自 quattuor（四）；quarta pars（第四份）即四分之一，英语 quart/quarter 由此
roots.core_concept: one of four equal parts / 均分成四份里的一份
roots.core_image: 一张饼横竖各切一刀，正好四块，取走其中一块

roots.origin: 拉丁语 sidus（属格 sideris：星、星座）；considerare 本义是「细看星象」（con＋sidus），古人观星定吉凶，故引申为反复审量。desire 亦出此支
roots.core_concept: to study the stars closely before deciding / 定夺之前先把星象细看一遍
roots.core_image: 夜里抬头把星位一颗颗对过，才决定明天动不动身

roots.origin: 拉丁语 instaurare（重新立起、复原、备置），经古法语 estorer 入英语；restore 是 re-＋staurare（再立起），store 本义是「备置存下的物资」
roots.core_concept: to set a thing up again and keep it ready / 重新立好，并存着备用
roots.core_image: 倒下的架子重新扶起立稳，东西一件件搬回架上码好
roots.english_definition: to set up again, renew, lay in store

concepts.concept: being right here in front, not elsewhere
concepts.core_image: 点名点到的人应了一声，抬头就见他站在那儿

concepts.concept: to declare one's standing out loud before all
concepts.core_image: 站到众人面前开口，把自己认下的本事讲明

concepts.concept: to set a thing up again and keep it ready

words.root_logic: prae-（在前）+ sent（在）→ 正在眼前的 → 出席的、当下的；引申为送到眼前之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesens（在眼前的），praeesse（在前）的现在分词
words.native_definition: in this place now; happening now; a gift given to someone
words.core_concept: standing here where one can be seen – 就站在这儿、看得见的那个状态
words.core_image: 点到名字，那人在后排应了一声抬起手
examples: All the students were present.
She gave him a birthday present.
semantic_expansions: 出席的：人就在眼前这儿
现在的：时间上正在眼前的这一段
礼物：拿到人眼前递过去的那件
words.recall_hint: prae-（在前）+ sent（在）→ 正在眼前的

words.root_logic: present（在眼前）+ -ence → 人在此处这件事；引申为身上那股压得住场的气派
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesentia（在场），来自 praesens ← praeesse
words.native_definition: the state of being in a place; an impressive manner
words.core_concept: the fact that one is here rather than away – 人在此而不在别处这个事实
words.core_image: 他一进门，满屋的说话声就低了半度
examples: Your presence is required at the meeting.
She has real stage presence.
semantic_expansions: 出席/存在：人或物就在此处这件事
气度：在场时压得住场面的那股劲
words.recall_hint: present（在眼前）+ -ence → 人在此处这件事

words.root_logic: present（当下）+ -ly → 就眼下而言；也表「过一会儿就」
words.origin: 英语 presently，来自 present ← 拉丁语 praeesse
words.native_definition: at the present time; soon, after a short while
words.core_concept: at the point one is standing on, or just past it – 就在所站的这一刻，或刚过这一刻
words.core_image: 他说了句稍等，转身进屋，没几步又折回来了
examples: He is presently working abroad.
The doctor will see you presently.
semantic_expansions: 目前：就眼下这一刻而言
不久/很快：刚过眼下这一刻就到
words.recall_hint: present（当下）+ -ly → 就眼下这一刻，或刚过这一刻

words.root_logic: pro-（众人前）+ fess（承认）+ -ion → 当众声明自己所执的那门业 → 职业
words.origin: 拉丁语 professio（公开声明、所执之业），来自 profiteri
words.native_definition: a paid job needing special training; an open declaration
words.core_concept: the calling one names aloud as one's own – 当众说出「我干这一行」的那门业
words.core_image: 他报出自己那一行，众人便知他受过哪套训练
examples: She entered the legal profession.
He made a profession of loyalty.
semantic_expansions: 职业/专业：当众声明所执、需专门训练的那一行
声明：把立场当众说出口这件事
words.recall_hint: pro-（众人前）+ fess（承认）→ 当众说出所执的那门业

words.root_logic: profess（当众讲明）+ -or（人）→ 在讲堂上当众讲学的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 professor（公开讲授者），来自 profiteri
words.native_definition: a teacher of the highest rank at a university
words.core_concept: the one who stands up and expounds before all – 站到众人前讲说的那个人
words.core_image: 他站上讲台，把那套道理从头讲给满堂人听
examples: The professor published a new study.
She was made professor at forty.
semantic_expansions: 教授：在讲堂上当众讲学、位阶最高的教师
words.recall_hint: profess（当众讲明）+ -or → 站到众人前讲说的人

words.root_logic: pro-（沿着）+ fil（线）+ -e → 沿边描出的那条线 → 侧影；引申为人物概况
words.origin: 意大利语 profilo（侧影、轮廓），来自 profilare ← pro＋filum（线）
words.native_definition: a side view of someone's face; a short description of a person
words.core_concept: the single line left when an edge is traced – 沿着边描一遍后剩下的那条线
words.core_image: 灯打在墙上，只剩一条贴着脸缘的黑边
examples: He was photographed in profile.
Her profile appeared in the magazine.
semantic_expansions: 侧面/轮廓：沿边描出的那条线
简介：把人的要点勾出一条轮廓
words.recall_hint: pro-（沿着）+ fil（线）→ 沿边描出的那条线

words.root_logic: pro-（合乎）+ sper（所盼）→ 事情合着所盼往好处走 → 兴旺
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperare（使顺利），来自 prosperus（合所盼的）← pro＋spes（希望）
words.native_definition: to succeed and do well, especially financially
words.core_concept: moving along just as one had hoped it would – 一路照着所盼的样子往前走
words.core_image: 铺子头一年只两三个客，第三年桌子摆到了门外
examples: The business prospered under her care.
Few crops prosper in dry soil.
semantic_expansions: 兴旺/繁荣/成功：事情顺着所盼一路往好处走
words.recall_hint: pro-（合乎）+ sper（所盼）→ 照所盼的样子走下去

words.root_logic: prosper（兴旺）+ -ity → 兴旺这个状态 → 繁荣、富足
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperitas（顺利、昌盛），来自 prosperus
words.native_definition: the state of being successful and having plenty of money
words.core_concept: the condition of things having gone as hoped – 事情已照所盼走成的那个局面
words.core_image: 满仓的粮堆到梁下，院里车马进出不断
examples: The country enjoyed years of prosperity.
They shared in the town's prosperity.
semantic_expansions: 繁荣/富足/兴旺：事情已照所盼走成的那个局面
words.recall_hint: prosper（兴旺）+ -ity → 已照所盼走成的局面

words.root_logic: prosper（兴旺）+ -ous（…的）→ 正处在兴旺里的
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperus（顺利的、合所盼的），来自 pro＋spes
words.native_definition: successful and having plenty of money
words.core_concept: standing in the state that hope aimed at – 正站在所盼的那个局面里
words.core_image: 他家门前石阶新换过，仓房也添了一间
examples: It is a prosperous farming region.
He came from a prosperous family.
semantic_expansions: 繁荣的/富裕的/成功的：正处在所盼那个局面里的
words.recall_hint: prosper（兴旺）+ -ous → 正处在所盼局面里的

words.root_logic: quart（第四）+ -er → 四份中的一份；引申为一年的四分之一、城中一区
words.origin: 古法语 quartier，来自拉丁语 quartarius（四分之一）← quartus
words.native_definition: one of four equal parts; three months of a year; a district of a town
words.core_concept: the single piece left when a whole is cut in four – 整体切成四块后取的那一块
words.core_image: 横竖各一刀，取走其中一块，手里正好是整张的一份
examples: Cut the apple into quarters.
Sales rose in the final quarter.
semantic_expansions: 四分之一：整体分四份后的一份
季度：一年切成四份后的一份
地区：城中划出的那一块
words.recall_hint: quart（第四）+ -er → 整体切四块后的那一块

words.root_logic: quartus（第四）→ 一加仑的四分之一，作容量单位
words.origin: 古法语 quarte，来自拉丁语 quarta（第四份）← quartus
words.native_definition: a unit of liquid measure equal to a quarter of a gallon
words.core_concept: the measure that is one of four in a gallon – 一加仑分作四份中的一份
words.core_image: 壶里的奶倒满四回，正好把大桶灌平
examples: Add a quart of milk to the pan.
The recipe calls for two quarts of water.
semantic_expansions: 夸脱：等于一加仑四分之一的容量单位
words.recall_hint: quartus（第四）→ 一加仑的四分之一

words.root_logic: quarter（季度）+ -ly（每…的）→ 每季一次的
words.origin: 英语 quarterly，来自 quarter ← 拉丁语 quartus
words.native_definition: happening or produced once every three months
words.core_concept: coming round once in each of the four parts of a year – 一年四份里各来一回
words.core_image: 账本一年结四回，每回隔三个月
examples: The company files quarterly reports.
She receives a quarterly payment.
semantic_expansions: 季度的/每季一次的：一年四份里各来一回
words.recall_hint: quarter（季度）+ -ly → 一年四份里各来一回

words.root_logic: con-（仔细）+ sider（星象）→ 像看星象那样反复审量 → 考虑；引申为认为
words.origin: 拉丁语 considerare（细察星象、审量），来自 con＋sidus（星）
words.native_definition: to think about something carefully; to regard in a certain way
words.core_concept: going over the signs one by one before settling – 定夺前把各处一一对过
words.core_image: 他抬头把满天的星位挨个对过，才开口说话
examples: Please consider my proposal.
She is considered an expert.
semantic_expansions: 考虑/顾及：像对星位那样一一审量
认为：审量之后得出的看法
words.recall_hint: con-（仔细）+ sider（星象）→ 像看星象那样反复审量

words.root_logic: consider（审量）+ -able（值得…的）→ 值得专门审量的 → 相当大的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 considerabilis（值得注意的），来自 considerare
words.native_definition: great in amount, extent, or importance
words.core_concept: big enough to be worth going over carefully – 大到值得专门拿来审量一遍
words.core_image: 报上来的数目不小，掌事的把册子翻了两遍
examples: They spent a considerable sum.
She has considerable influence here.
semantic_expansions: 相当大的/可观的：大到值得专门审量一遍
重要的：因分量重而须审量
words.recall_hint: consider（审量）+ -able → 大到值得专门审量

words.root_logic: consider（审量）+ -ation → 审量这件事；也指审量时须顾到的那一项、体谅
words.origin: 拉丁语 consideratio（细察、审量），来自 considerare
words.native_definition: careful thought; a factor to be taken into account; thoughtfulness
words.core_concept: the going-over itself, and each thing weighed in it – 审量这件事本身，及其中每一项须顾到的
words.core_image: 他把册子摊在灯下，一条条对过去，末了还问了句家里方便不方便
examples: The plan is under consideration.
He showed great consideration for others.
semantic_expansions: 考虑：审量这件事本身
考虑因素：审量时须顾到的那一项
体谅：顾到旁人处境的那份心
words.recall_hint: consider（审量）+ -ation → 审量这件事及所顾各项

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ stor（立起）→ 把倒下的重新立回原样 → 修复、恢复
words.origin: 古法语 restorer，来自拉丁语 restaurare（重新立起）← re＋staurare
words.native_definition: to bring something back to its former state; to give back
words.core_concept: putting a thing back up as it stood before – 把它照原先那样重新立回去
words.core_image: 散架的柜子一块块拼回去，扶正后又能立稳
examples: They restored the old church.
Power was restored within the hour.
semantic_expansions: 修复/恢复：把它照原先那样重新立回去
归还：把原属他人之物放回原处
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ stor（立起）→ 照原样重新立回去

words.root_logic: instaurare（备置）→ 备下存着的物资 → 储备；存放之处即店铺
words.origin: 古法语 estor（储备、供给），来自 instaurare（备置、重立）
words.native_definition: a supply kept for future use; a shop; to keep for later
words.core_concept: what is laid in and kept standing ready – 备下来、一直搁着待用的那批东西
words.core_image: 米袋一层层码到墙根，够撑过整个冬天
examples: Store the grain in a dry place.
She works at a grocery store.
semantic_expansions: 储存/储备：备下搁着待用的那批东西
商店：存放货物待售的那个处所
words.recall_hint: instaurare（备置）→ 备下待用之物；存物之处即店

words.root_logic: store（备存）+ -age → 存放这件事，及存放的地方与费用
words.origin: 英语 storage，来自 store ← 拉丁语 instaurare
words.native_definition: the keeping of things until needed; space for this
words.core_concept: the keeping-in-readiness, and the room it takes – 备着待用这件事，及所占的地方
words.core_image: 阁楼腾出半间，箱子摞起来到房梁
examples: We put the boxes into storage.
The phone has 128GB of storage.
semantic_expansions: 储存/存放：备着待用这件事
储藏空间：为此腾出的那块地方
words.recall_hint: store（备存）+ -age → 备着待用这件事及其处所
